tools.name: anvil_combine_cost
tools.description: Simulates exactly one Minecraft anvil operation — combining `item` (the base, left slot) with `sacrifice` (the right slot), optionally renaming the result — with no search or planning: it's a direct simulation of that specific in-game anvil use, not a 'find the cheapest way to reach X' query. Return

tools.name: anvil_migration_path
tools.description: Compute the cheapest Minecraft anvil combine path to migrate an item's existing enchantments (and prior-work penalty count) to a target enchantment set. sourceItem and targetItem must be the same item id (e.g. both 'diamond_sword') — a mismatch is a tool error, not a silent conversion. Inventory usa
